_meta.description: Per-type_id tile-level artifact extraction config. Universal — works for any save of any map. Each entry says: does this type always create an R_Art row, and if so, how to extract artifact_id from tile bytes.

5.notes: Ground artifact. raw[s+2] is the artifact_id. Has guard iff (raw[s+9] & 0x80) == 0x80 (PRT SaveArt:10145). When guarded, links to ArtRes record at index = art_res_num (per PRT AnalysisContent:6819).

22.notes: Corpse. Has artifact only when raw[s+8] == 0xFF. Then artifact_id is computed from bytes at s+6 (top 2 bits) and s+7 (bottom 6 bits). PRT source line 10322: TblArt.Rows.Find((decmp[s+7]<<2) + ((decmp[s+6]&0xC0)>>6)).

86.notes: Shipwreck Survivor. raw[s+6] is the artifact_id (always).

108.notes: Warrior's Tomb. Has artifact only when raw[s+6] == 31. Then artifact_id is computed from bytes at s+7 (top 5 bits) and s+8 (bottom 3 bits). PRT source line 10553.
